   significance: "significant" | "ordinary" | "procedural" ("normal" = ordinary). Short does not mean skip the label — a 2-page doctrinal quash is still "significant".

"consumer" (relief granted: connection directed, bill quashed, restoration ordered) | "licensee" (writ dismissed / mandamus refused / licensee's challenge allowed) | "alternate_remedy" (relegated to 6.5/6.8/s.127 or "apply/consider in accordance with law" without a merits grant or refusal) | "pending" (listed, interlocutory) | "none" (infructuous, not-pressed, withdrawn, contempt dismissed without deciding the bill) | "split".    facts: one short paragraph (~60–90 words), the story not the holding.
   holding_units: usually one. {provision, code, clause, topic, type, holding, paras, flag?}. Omit question unless it adds something the holding does not say.
